summary:
Build attempt 3 (0ecee0a) changes no code. `git diff --stat bd556e5 0ecee0a` touches only .taad/slices/SL-033 records. The same diff restricted to src, tests, eng, .taad/fitness.yaml, Directory.Build.props, global.json and FsAnalyser.slnx is empty, and so is the working tree against HEAD for src, tests and eng. The code is byte-for-byte what I reviewed and ran in attempt 2: C-006, C-012 and O-016 passed, all 8 mutants passed, Core tests were 120/120 and Fitness held 20 rules. No statement in the code, its comments or its messages has become false, because no behaviour moved.

The attempt exists because O-002 landed on build-slice after its pass. The builder discharged it by re-running existing tests, with no code change.

I re-ran WindowCases -Case C-006 at this head. The no-scan step refused after 20 s. In the main run the hook acted at 749 ms, and the after-acted check passed. The scan stopped at 550 of 30,150 folders, C-006 PASSED and the exit code was 0. My attempt-2 StopDisabled run is still valid for this code: the scan ended before the hook could act, and C-006 failed only on 'the hook acted'. That is O-002's shape, a missed scan reported as 'hook never acted', not as a wrong ending.

The slice history shows no loop. Each build attempt had a different cause (O-015's fix, then O-002 landing late), and attempt 3 honestly changes no code.

drift: Nothing new departed: build attempt 3 changed no code. The three drift notes from attempt 2 still stand. First, the comment at StartupHook.cs:127-129 names OnClosing as reaching the rethrow catch; measured, an OnClosing fault reaches App.DispatcherUnhandledException through the window procedure instead. Second, O-016 cannot tell a crash-on-close apart from the Exit rule path. Third, the design's 'never fatal' clause no longer holds for exceptions raised inside Act.
